sources.author: T. A. Fisher
sources.title: Invariants for the elliptic normal quintic
sources.read_scope: Sections9–10, printed33–37: smooth elliptic quintic secant via Jacobian of five quadrics; quadratic Omega and invariant differential. Smoothness is not asserted at the special nodal fiber.

sources.author: Alexander Polishchuk
sources.title: Feigin-Odesskii brackets, syzygies, and Cremona transformations
sources.read_scope: Introduction, printed1–3, TheoremA(i)(ii): Fisher Omega gives q(n,1) for smooth elliptic normal curves and has the secant equation as Casimir. Applied only to smooth generic e.

scope: The allmodel polynomial Omega formula is the already accepted public construction. The explicit Phi(e) has generic smooth elliptic fibers. Nonzero literal special identity then puts the special class in closedT39; no singular-curve extension theorem is assumed.
